title: Bounded multiple cached scalar contents in linked TABLECONTENT cell

scope.operation: Write one cached scalar content in a linked-data cell inside a rectangular TABLECONTENT grid.
scope.profile: Generated 2x2 AC1032 table: one linked cell carrying a cached string followed by an integer, three scalar string cells, and one DATALINK; ASCII and binary DXF.
scope.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 20.4.97.3: linked-target fields are conditional on the linked flag, followed by the cell-content count and content sequence.
limits: One linked cell and the selected two-item string-then-integer content sequence
No linked-cell block references, attributes, geometry, formatting, or multiple cached contents
scope.claim_boundary: Selected DXF serializer and typed readback evidence only; no native application semantics or DWG encoding claim.

implementation: Classify the table shape before applying the legacy single-cell content checks; the multi-cell path now reaches its own complete grid validator.
Allow a linked grid cell to carry an ordered sequence of already-supported scalar contents while retaining DATALINK handle validation and graph-closure preflight.
Emit linked metadata and the unconditional group 95 content count/list independently.

physical_wire: The linked cell emits 92=1, remapped 340=0x1710, 93=2, 94=3, 96=-5 and 95=2.
The ordered content sequence emits scalar type 1 and the VALUE marker for the exact string cached-north-west, followed by scalar type 1 and integer value 42.
One DATALINK record is emitted at 0x1710; all four cell content counts and linked flags are checked.
evidence.typed_readback: The TABLECONTENT handle is 0x15A0; the linked cell points to DATALINK 0x1710, retains row/column metadata 2/3 and unknown value -5, and reads back ordered string data type 4 plus integer data type 1/value 42. Scalar peer values remain present.
evidence.failure_control: Changing the linked-cell target to absent handle 0x799 is refused; an existing destination sentinel and the caller's changed source model remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring the valid source target lets the same adapter export again; the linked graph and both cached contents read back intact.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.

This receipt does not qualify multiple linked cells, other content sequences/types, block/field/attribute/geometry payloads on linked cells, broader DATALINK semantics, native TABLE rendering, or DWG output.
